label: Figure 11.16: Short-run losses in monopolistic competition
alt: D = AR, MR, MC and AC with AC above the price: at the output q where MC = MR the average cost C exceeds P, and the shaded rectangle between C and P is a loss.
caption: The firm produces at q where MC = MR and charges P from the AR curve, but here the whole AR curve lies below AC. At q the average cost C is above P, so it makes a loss of (C − P) × q, shown by the shaded rectangle.
